remarks: Discover your perfect rental in Stamford! This newly renovated two-bedroom, one-bath apartment boasts views of Bedford St in downtown Stamford. Revel in the luxury of brand new finishes, featuring a sleek, modern kitchen and an elegantly updated bathroom. Enjoy the convenience of a private parking spot and easy access to local shops, dining, and public transportation. This move-in ready gem offers the perfect blend of comfort and style, ideal for those seeking the finest in urban living. Don't miss out on this exceptional opportunity.
